description:
Zorvu's automated risk check on any Robinhood Chain token: the grade, each check that ran with its result and reason, a drainer-code check, and when every underlying reading was taken.

It covers any token address. For a whole transaction, `precheck_transaction` also decodes the calldata and checks the spender.

The drainer-code check and the official Stock Token lookalike check (on the token's live `symbol()` and `name()`) run live. Zorvu's other token measurements (liquidity, holders, sell test, deployer history) are archived readings: an archived reading never counts as a pass, may support a warn or a fail for 7 days with its date in `reading_at`, and is not used after that. `token_data` says which applies (`archived` or `none`). The grade says what those checks measured at the time shown; it never means the token is safe or safe to buy, and it is not a recommendation. While Zorvu's token measurements are an archive the grade is `Not yet checked`, `Limited data`, `Elevated risk`, `High risk`, or `Not applicable` for a base asset of the chain. It is never `Low risk` today, so `passed_zorvu_safety_checks` is `false` on every answer: it carries no signal and does not mean the token failed. A check Zorvu could not run is `no_data` or `inconclusive`, never a pass. These are measurements, not advice; they may be incomplete, wrong or out of date. Not financial advice.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain.

name: check_token

grade.description: What Zorvu's automated checks measured: Not applicable, Not yet checked, Limited data, Elevated risk or High risk. Never Low risk while the token measurements are an archive, because an archived reading never counts as a pass.

passed_zorvu_safety_checks.description: true only when the grade is Low risk, so false on every answer while the token measurements are an archive. Not the same field as the one on each entry of precheck_transaction’s tokens[], which has its own rule.
